timeField.hint: Type it, or move it with ↑ and ↓ a quarter of an hour at a time; with Shift, an hour.

header.newJobHint: Create a job and append it to the queue
header.absencesHint: Book a gap or close whole days

summary.label: Workshop load
summary.bookedFridayFree: Workshop booked until {{date}} · {{hours}} h queued · Friday free
summary.bookedFridayBusy: Workshop booked until {{date}} · {{hours}} h queued · Friday {{bufferDate}} already carries work
summary.freeFridayFree: Workshop free · nothing queued · Friday free
summary.freeFridayBusy: Workshop free Monday to Thursday · nothing queued · Friday {{bufferDate}} carries work
summary.bufferHint: Friday is the buffer: it only takes the overflow of work that grew, and it empties itself again as Monday to Thursday frees up.
summary.capacityBelowShift: Auto-fill: {{capacity}} h of the {{shift}} h shift

day.todayHint: Today can still be re-planned in full. Lock the work you have already started.
day.frozenHint: The engine never writes in the past, but you can still edit it by hand.
day.bufferHint: Friday is the buffer: it only takes the overflow of work that grew.
day.weekendHint: Weekend: outside the engine. Manual drag only.

grid.label: Workshop week
grid.bandsLegend: Grey bands: visual margins and lunch — manual drag only
grid.dropRankHint: Dropping sets the block's place in the queue; it then settles right behind the block before it. To keep it at the exact time, put the padlock on before you move it.
grid.createRail: Drag here to create a job or a gap at this time.
grid.dropCuts: This will cut "{{name}}": the rest carries on right behind, and continues on the next day if this one runs out.
grid.dropDisplaces: Moves "{{name}}" aside: that whole block goes right behind, and continues on the next day if this one runs out.
grid.dropMerges: This will merge with "{{name}}": the hours are summed into one block.
grid.dropOnGap: A block dropped there keeps the exact slot, and those hours are a reserved gap. Nothing will be saved.
grid.dropBlocked: A block dropped there keeps the exact slot, and those hours belong to "{{name}}", which is locked. Nothing will be saved.
grid.dropPinHint: Dropping leaves the block at the exact time you release it and puts the padlock on: the engine will not move it from there. Take it off whenever you want to hand it back.
grid.dropTakesRank: Takes its place in the queue here
grid.dropSlid: Something there does not move: the block will drop down to {{time}}.
grid.dropNextDay: No room lower down that day: it goes to {{day}}.
grid.dropNoLower: No lower: {{hours}} h cannot start after {{time}}.
grid.dropLongerThanDay: {{hours}} h do not fit in one day: the day holds {{dayHours}} h at most, so this stretch does not end today.
grid.placingHint: Click the day and the time where the separated part should go. Press Esc to leave things as they were.
grid.gapDrag: Drag to take the absence to another time or another day
grid.gapResize: Change how long the absence lasts
grid.gapDragHint: A gap stays at the exact time you release it, cut at the lunch break if it has to be, and both halves travel together. If there is locked, weekend or past work in those hours, nothing will be saved.
grid.gapResizeHint: Drag the bottom edge to change how long the absence lasts. It is counted in working hours, it skips the lunch break, and it asks nothing: there is no job here to hand hours to.
grid.gapBlocked: There are hours of "{{name}}" there that the engine cannot move. Nothing will be saved.
grid.gapCuts: This will cut "{{name}}" in two: the hours after it carry on right behind the gap, and continue on the next day if this one runs out.
grid.gapDisplaces: Moves "{{name}}" aside: those hours go behind it and, if the day runs out, carry on the next day.
grid.edgePrevious: Hold the block here to go to the previous week · {{range}}
grid.edgeNext: Hold the block here to go to the next week · {{range}}

block.drag: Drag to change its place in the queue
block.label: {{name}} · {{day}} · {{start}}–{{end}} · {{hours}} h
block.deleteBody: {{hours}} h will come off "{{name}}" and the job's total will drop to {{total}} h. This cannot be undone.
block.deleteOnlyBlock: This is the job's only block. To remove it, delete the whole job.
block.splitHint: The split-off part takes a place in the queue and then settles; it does not stay at the time you drop it. Lock it if you need it pinned.
block.resizeHint: Growing a block takes those hours from the job’s last block; shrinking it gives them back. The total does not move unless you stretch past what the job can give, and then it asks. Reaching into a margin padlocks the row, so the engine cannot pull it back.
block.markLocked: Locked · the engine never moves it from here

jobPanel.title: Job
jobPanel.name: Name
jobPanel.namePlaceholder: Give it a name you will recognise
jobPanel.totalHoursHint: Raising them adds the hours to the job's last block; lowering them takes the hours off it.
jobPanel.noBlocks: This job has no blocks yet.
jobPanel.deleteBody_one: Its block will be deleted and the calendar will recompose. This cannot be undone.
jobPanel.deleteBody_other: Its {{count}} blocks will be deleted and the calendar will recompose. This cannot be undone.

jobForm.title: New job
jobForm.hint: The job is appended to the end of the queue and fills Monday to Thursday. Friday is the buffer and never takes new jobs.
jobForm.startHint: It means “not before that day”. Not a deadline: it only decides where the job is born.
jobForm.startNothing: With that date no hours fit before the end of the planning horizon.
jobForm.startDeferred: The workshop is booked until {{until}}, so the job does not start on {{chosen}}: it starts on {{date}}. The date is a floor, not a reservation.
jobForm.startForced: It goes on {{date}} and whatever follows moves forward. Same as creating it and dragging it there.
jobForm.startAutoLock: The engine does not fill the calendar as far as that date, so its blocks are created locked: without the padlock it would fill forward and pull them back before their time. It is the ordinary padlock: visible, and removable.
jobForm.startBuffer: That is a Friday, the buffer: the engine never puts new work there. Chosen by hand it is honoured, and the block is created locked so the engine will not reclaim it.
jobForm.startWeekend: That is a weekend: outside the engine. Chosen by hand it is honoured, and the block is created locked.
jobForm.startPast: That date is in the past: the blocks are created there and locked, as a record of work that was done but never logged. The engine never writes to the past.
jobForm.startClosed: That day is closed: the engine plans nothing on it. Chosen by hand it is honoured, and the block is created locked.
jobForm.startPainted: The hours start exactly where you painted, locked, so the engine will not move them. Whatever does not fit in the day carries on the next one.
jobForm.offWeekTitle: That day is not on screen
jobForm.offWeek: The band lands on {{date}}, outside the week you are looking at.
jobForm.startClear: Nothing is in the way on those days.
jobForm.startCollisions_one: There are already {{hours}} h of another job on those days:
jobForm.startCollisions_other: There are already {{hours}} h across {{count}} other jobs on those days:
jobForm.startLockedStands: A locked block is not displaced: it stands, and the new job splits around it and carries on after it.
jobForm.startForce: Place it that day and push what is there
jobForm.startForceHint: Same as creating the job and dragging it there. Anything locked stays put.
jobForm.confirmBufferTitle: Create the job on a Friday?
jobForm.confirmBufferBody: {{date}} is a Friday, the buffer: it only takes the overflow of work that has grown. Put there by hand it stays there, locked, and the engine will not reclaim it.
jobForm.confirmWeekendTitle: Create the job on the weekend?
jobForm.confirmWeekendBody: {{date}} is a weekend and is not planned: it sits outside the engine and only moves by hand.
jobForm.confirmClosedTitle: Create the job on a closed day?
jobForm.confirmClosedBody: {{date}} is closed and the engine plans nothing on it. Put there by hand it stays there, locked, and the engine will not reclaim it.
jobForm.createdLocked: The blocks were created locked on that date. Remove the padlock whenever you want to hand the job back to the engine.
jobForm.createdDayLocked: The block stays locked on that day: you chose it and the engine will not reclaim it. Remove the padlock whenever you want to hand it back.

gapForm.closeDaySpan: It reserves {{start}} to {{end}}: the day loses {{hours}} h of plannable time.
gapForm.closeDayMoves: These hours cannot stay there; the engine replans them:
gapForm.closeDayMovesNone: There is no flexible work after that time: it only reserves the time.
gapForm.closeDayWhole: A job that does not fit in the hours left moves whole to the next day with room.
gapForm.closeDayHint: The gap is what makes the day hold fewer plannable hours. It can be edited or deleted later like any other gap.
gapForm.closeDayLocked: There is locked work inside that stretch ({{names}}): unlock or move it, or the gap cannot be saved.
gapForm.closeDayNoRoom: There is no plannable time left to close at that time.
gapForm.hint: A gap is time: it consumes the day's plannable hours exactly like a locked block. Saving it moves the flexible work out of the way.
gapForm.lunchNote: Lunch is not a gap: it is the space between the two periods of the shift, set in Settings.
gapForm.blockedHint: If the space is held by a locked block, a past day or a weekend, the gap is not saved — unlock or move that block first.
gapForm.deleteBody: {{hours}} h on {{date}} will be freed and the calendar will recompose.

absenceForm.title: Absences
absenceForm.modeGapHint: A few hours of the day: a breakdown, errands, half an afternoon.
absenceForm.modeClosedHint: Holidays, a fair, a public holiday: the whole day, with no plannable hours.
absenceForm.closesDays_one: {{count}} day will be closed: it loses its plannable hours.
absenceForm.closesDays_other: {{count}} days will be closed: they lose their plannable hours.
absenceForm.alreadyClosed_one: {{days}} is already closed. Saving only changes the reason; “Reopen” opens it again.
absenceForm.alreadyClosed_other: Already closed: {{days}}. Saving only changes the reason; “Reopen” opens them again.
absenceForm.alreadyClosedGap: Already closed: {{days}}. The gap is saved all the same, but those days had no hours to take.
absenceForm.repeatsDaily: The same gap, at the same time, on each of the {{count}} days.
absenceForm.cutAtBreak: Each day is stored as two rows, because the gap crosses the lunch break.
absenceForm.skippedWeekend: The weekend is skipped ({{days}}): it is outside the engine.
absenceForm.movesNothing: It moves no work at all.
absenceForm.reachesFurther: The workshop will then be booked until {{date}}.
absenceForm.reopened_one: Day reopened: the queue fills it again.
absenceForm.reopened_other: {{count}} days reopened: the queue fills them again.
absenceForm.closedHint: A closed day behaves like a weekend: the engine plans nothing there, but you can still drop work on it by hand, and it stays.
absenceForm.noHalfDay: There is no half day: if the shop works fewer hours that day, that is a gap.
absenceForm.notePlaceholder: Why you are closing those days

holidayPanel.title: Public holidays with work on them
holidayPanel.body: These days are public holidays and there is work on them. Choose what to do with each; the rest have been closed already.

dayWork.title: These days have work on them
dayWork.fixed: The day closes with the work where it is: it is padlocked, and only you can unlock it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Shift, auto-fill and the look of the calendar.
settings.shiftHint: The shift is split: morning, lunch and afternoon. The space between the two periods is lunch and is never stored as a gap.
settings.period2EnabledHint: Switch it off and the day ends when the morning does. The daily capacity is never changed on its own: if it no longer fits, you are asked before saving.
settings.shiftTotal: The shift adds up to {{hours}} h.
settings.defaultDayCapacityHint: This is only the stop line for auto-fill: it lets you fill less than the full shift so the shop can close early. It never limits what you place by hand, and it can never exceed the shift. Maximum with the current shift: {{max}} h.
settings.capacityBelowShift: Auto-fill uses {{capacity}} h of the {{shift}} h shift: {{free}} h of every day stay free. You can still place work in them by hand.
settings.capacityWillLower: On saving, the capacity will drop from {{from}} h to {{to}} h — the most the enabled periods add up to.
settings.capacityLowerConfirm: The daily capacity will drop from {{from}} h to {{to}} h, because that is the most the remaining periods add up to.
settings.capacityLowerCost: Auto-fill will plan {{lost}} h less each day, so queued work moves to later days.
settings.marginsHint: Grey bands drawn before and after the shift, from {{min}} to {{max}} h. They accept manual drag only: auto-fill never enters them.
settings.timelinePreview: The calendar is drawn from {{start}} to {{end}}.
settings.planningHorizonWeeksHint: Auto-fill never creates blocks beyond this many weeks from today. Between {{min}} and {{max}} weeks.
settings.planningHorizonWarning: If you narrow it and the queued work no longer fits, nothing is saved — neither the horizon nor the rest of the changes.
settings.gapColorHint: Every gap on the calendar is painted this colour.
settings.languageHint: It can be changed at any time and is remembered on this machine.
settings.backupsHint: Automatic copies are kept beside the database, in {{directory}}.
settings.backupsEnabledHint: Checked when the app opens: if the newest copy is older than the interval, another is taken. Nothing runs while the app is closed.
settings.backupsKeptHint: Taking a new copy deletes the oldest until this many remain. It only ever deletes automatic copies: one you saved yourself is left alone.
settings.backupsListEmpty: None yet. The first is taken next time the app opens.
settings.backupsLoad: Load a copy from my PC
settings.backupsRestoreBody: The calendar as it is now is replaced by the copy from {{date}} at {{time}}. A copy of the current one is taken first, so this can be undone.
settings.backupsRestoreFileBody: The calendar as it is now is replaced by the one in “{{file}}”. A copy of the current one is taken first, so this can be undone.
settings.backupSaved: Copy saved as “{{file}}” in the chosen location.
settings.backupDownloaded: Copy downloaded as “{{file}}” to the browser’s downloads folder. Open the app on “localhost” to be able to choose a location.
settings.holidaysHint: The workshop closes on its municipality's public holidays. The app brings them in; the ones with work on them ask before moving anything.
settings.holidaysEnabledHint: Switching it off removes none of the days already closed.
settings.holidaysCheckFailed: They could not be checked. Last attempt on {{date}}
settings.holidaysCheckedNothing: Everything was already up to date
settings.holidaysAttribution: Data: Junta de Andalucía and festivos.io (CC BY 4.0)

notices.touchedLockedBlocks_one: One locked block was adjusted because the job had no unlocked hours left.
notices.touchedLockedBlocks_other: {{count}} locked blocks were adjusted because the job had no unlocked hours left.
notices.dropSettles: The block takes the place where you dropped it and settles right behind the one before it. To keep it at the exact time, put the padlock on before you move it.
notices.dropPinned: "{{name}}" stays exactly where you dropped it, on {{day}}, and we put the padlock on it: the engine will not move it from there. Take it off whenever you want to hand it back.
notices.dropLeftWeek: "{{name}}" no longer fitted this week: its hours carry on from {{date}}.
notices.dropPulledBack: "{{name}}" has been laid out on {{date}}, before the week you are looking at: Monday to Thursday a drop changes its place in the queue, not its week, and the block settles where there was room. To take it to a particular week, put the padlock on before you move it, or drop it on Friday or at the weekend.
notices.dropMovedWeek: "{{name}}" now sits on {{date}}, in the week of {{week}} — the one you are looking at now. Press "Today" to come back to this week.
notices.dropFilled: "{{name}}" fills what was left of the day and carries on into the next one: {{parts}}. To keep it whole on one day, make room for it or put the padlock on.
notices.dropUnchanged: The queue put "{{name}}" back where it was: Monday to Thursday a drop changes its place, not its time. To leave it where you dropped it, put the padlock on first and then move it.
notices.dropAbsorbed: Those hours were merged into the block of the same job next to them. No hours were lost.
notices.dropRefusedPast: You cannot drop there: the past is frozen and the engine never writes in it. Correct that day from the job panel.
notices.dropRefusedPastGap: It cannot be dropped there: the past is frozen and the engine does not write to it. Change that absence in its own form instead.
notices.mergedOverlap_one: It was merged with the block of the same job that was already there. No hours were lost.
notices.mergedOverlap_other: It was merged with {{count}} blocks of the same job that were already there. No hours were lost.
notices.displacedBlocks_one: "{{names}}" was moved aside to make room and the engine re-placed its hours. Move it again if that is not what you wanted.
notices.displacedBlocks_other: {{count}} jobs were moved aside ({{names}}) to make room and the engine re-placed their hours. Move them again if that is not what you wanted.
notices.resizeShrunk: "{{name}}" is {{hours}} h here now, and the padlock is what holds that length. The spare hours go to the job's last block the engine still places, and whatever is behind it in the queue takes the room.
notices.resizeGrown: "{{name}}" is {{hours}} h here now, and the padlock is what holds that length. Those hours come off the job's last block; if this was the last one, the job's total goes up.
notices.pressWhileBusy: Hold on a moment: the previous change is still saving. The calendar accepts drags again as soon as it lands.
notices.pressOnPastDay: That day has already happened and is not dragged: it is the record of what you did. Change the hours from the job panel.
notices.pressOnPastGap: That day has already happened and is not dragged: it is the record of what you did. If the gap is wrong, correct it in its form.
notices.gapMovedTo: The absence is saved on {{day}} at {{time}}: nothing happens during the lunch break, so it starts at the first minute that can hold work.
notices.gapResized: The absence is {{hours}} h long now. Whatever was in those hours is pushed aside; to change its day or its reason, click the gap.
notices.deletedJobPast_one: The job was deleted. The hour already worked stays on the calendar as a gap, so the day keeps its shape.
notices.deletedJobPast_other: The job was deleted. The {{count}} parts already worked stay on the calendar as gaps, so those days keep their shape.
notices.backupRestored: Calendar restored. The previous one was saved as “{{name}}” in the backups folder.

undo.clearedBySettings: Saving the settings emptied the history: the shift those blocks were laid out against is gone.
undo.closePanel: Close what you have open and try again: with a panel or a form in front, undo stays out of the way rather than throwing away something half written.
undo.drifted: The calendar changed by another route, so the history was emptied. Nothing was undone.

resizeChoice.title: What should happen to those {{hours}} h?
resizeChoice.body: «{{name}}» has no other block that can take them: the rest are locked, on the weekend or already past.
resizeChoice.reduceTotal: Take them off the job's total
resizeChoice.newBlock: Split: leave them as a block of their own
resizeChoice.newBlockHint: They stay as a loose block you can place wherever you like.
resizeChoice.addToTotal: Add the hours to the total
resizeChoice.addToTotalHint: The job becomes that many hours bigger.
resizeChoice.growTitle: Add those {{hours}} h to the job?
resizeChoice.growBody: «{{name}}» has nowhere to take them from: its other blocks are locked, on the weekend, already past, or do not hold that much. Lengthening it here makes the job bigger.

errors.horizonExceeded: The hours do not fit inside the planning horizon. Widen the horizon in Settings or reduce the hours.
errors.horizonExceededUntil: The hours do not fit before {{date}}, the end of the planning horizon. Widen the horizon in Settings or reduce the hours. Nothing was saved.
errors.invalidDuration: The duration must be greater than zero.
errors.growNeedsChoice: You stretched «{{name}}» {{hours}} h beyond what the rest of the job can give. Add them to the job’s total?
errors.shrinkNeedsChoice: The hours you are freeing have no block to go to: the others are locked, on the weekend or already past. Tell me what to do with them.
errors.reductionExceedsJob: You cannot remove more hours than the job has.
errors.paintedNoRoom: There is no room left in the day at that time. Start the job earlier, or pick another day.
errors.paintedOverGap: You already have a gap there. Move or delete it, or start the job at another time.
errors.paintedOverLockedBlock: "{{projectName}}" is there, locked, and the engine cannot move it. Unlock or move it, or start the job at another time.
errors.paintedOverPastBlock: "{{projectName}}" is there, on a past day, and the past is not touched. Start the job at another time.
errors.paintedOverWeekendBlock: "{{projectName}}" is there, on the weekend, where only you can move it. Move it by hand, or start the job at another time.
errors.gapOverGap: That gap overlaps another one you already have on {{date}} from {{startTime}} to {{endTime}}{{reasonSuffix}}. Move or delete it before saving.
errors.gapOverLockedBlock: That gap lands on "{{projectName}}", which is locked on {{date}} from {{startTime}} to {{endTime}}. Unlock or move it before saving.
errors.gapOverPastBlock: That gap lands on "{{projectName}}", which is on a past day ({{date}}, {{startTime}} to {{endTime}}). Correct that block by hand before saving.
errors.gapOverWeekendBlock: That gap lands on "{{projectName}}", which is on the weekend ({{date}}, {{startTime}} to {{endTime}}). Move it by hand before saving.
errors.closedDayOverPastBlock: {{date}} cannot be closed: “{{projectName}}” sits from {{startTime}} to {{endTime}} on a day already past, and the past is not touched.
errors.dropOverLockedBlock: A block dropped there keeps the exact slot, and those hours belong to "{{projectName}}", which is locked ({{date}}, {{startTime}} to {{endTime}}). Unlock it, or drop it at another time. Nothing was saved.
errors.dropOverGap: A block dropped there keeps the exact slot, and those hours are a reserved gap ({{date}}, {{startTime}} to {{endTime}}). Drop it at another time, or delete the gap. Nothing was saved.
errors.mergeExceedsDay: Merging the two blocks of the same job would not fit inside the day ({{date}}). Drop it earlier. Nothing was saved.
errors.displacedHoursUnplaceable: There is nowhere for the hours "{{projectName}}" has left after that drop. Widen the horizon in Settings or drop somewhere else. Nothing was saved.
errors.invalidPayload: The request could not be read.
errors.invalidColor: That colour is not one of the job swatches.
errors.invalidTotalHours: Total hours must be a number greater than zero.
errors.invalidDate: The date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.
errors.invalidTime: That time does not fit inside the day.
errors.invalidTimeFormat: The time must be in HH:mm format.
errors.timeOutOfBounds: That time has to be between {{startTime}} and {{endTime}}.
errors.invalidRange: That date range is not valid: "To" must be the same day as "From" or later, and at most {{maxDays}} days long.
errors.rangeBackwards: That range runs backwards: "To" has to be the same day as "From" or later.
errors.invalidReason: That gap reason is not valid.
errors.invalidFlag: That value must be true or false.
errors.rowExceedsDay: That block does not fit inside the day: starting at {{startTime}} on {{date}} it would run past midnight. Shorten it or move it to another time. Nothing was saved.
errors.rowPastDayEnd: That would run past the end of the day: it would finish at {{endTime}} on {{date}} and the day ends at {{dayEndTime}} (margin included). Make it shorter or start it earlier. Nothing was saved.
errors.splitExceedsBlock: The part you are splitting off must be smaller than the block. To move the whole block, drag it.
errors.splitBelowMinimum: Both pieces have to be at least a quarter of an hour. Split off a bigger part, or move the whole block. Nothing was saved.
errors.deleteLastBlock: This is the job's only block. To remove it, delete the whole job.
errors.pastBlockFrozen: That day is already past: it is the record of what you did, and it is not edited. Change the hours in the job form instead.
errors.pastGapFrozen: That day is already past: it is the record of what you did, and it is not dragged. If the gap is wrong, correct it in its form.
errors.dropOntoPastDay: You cannot drop onto a day that is already past: the past is the record of what you did.
errors.invariantViolated: The block hours do not add up to the job's hours. Nothing was saved.
errors.settingsInvalid: That setting value is not valid.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved.
errors.loadFailed: The workshop data could not be loaded.
errors.networkFailed: No connection to the server. Nothing was saved.
errors.notFound: That no longer exists. Reload the calendar.
errors.title: Could not be completed
errors.backupNotFound: That copy is no longer in the folder. Nothing was changed.
errors.backupNotADatabase: That file is not a database. Choose the .db of a Workwise copy. Nothing was changed.
errors.backupNotWorkwise: That file is a database, but not a Workwise one. Nothing was changed.
